items.title: Per-project secure development VMs
items.oneliner: Open source CLI spins up one isolated VM per project to protect secrets, cache toolchains, and run coding agents safely.

items.title: Zero-trust runtime for AI agents
items.oneliner: POSIX sandbox for AI agents blocks tool hijacks with deterministic policies and claims sub-0.016 ms threat interception.

items.title: Rust UI framework with live editing
items.oneliner: GPU-rendered Rust UI framework targets desktop and web, with headless rendering and state-preserving live view editing.

items.title: Blender UI outside Blender
items.oneliner: Library exposes Blender's fast UI runtime to Python, Rust, JavaScript, and C for lightweight native app interfaces.

items.title: Python exercises with built-in tests
items.oneliner: Rustlings-style Python repo gives 55 exercises plus instant test feedback for interview prep and skill refreshers.

items.title: UEFI bare-metal programming walkthrough
items.oneliner: Hands-on series shows Linux developers how to compile, boot, and debug bare-metal UEFI apps from scratch.

items.title: Prompt regression testing CLI
items.oneliner: CLI test framework helps teams turn prompt checks into repeatable regression suites instead of manual spot testing.

items.title: WebVR framework with HTML primitives
items.oneliner: Open source framework lets developers build browser VR scenes with HTML components across desktop, mobile, and major headsets.

items.title: Monospace font that reveals tokens
items.oneliner: Experimental font uses OpenType rules to visualize LLM token boundaries as you type, without JavaScript.

items.title: Mac-native open globe explorer
items.oneliner: macOS globe app uses OpenStreetMap data, offline caching, and smooth 3D navigation as a Google Earth alternative.
